artifacts.normalisation: Published bytes differ from the emitted bytes by trailing whitespace only. The publishing repository's pre-commit gate runs end-of-file-fixer and trailing-whitespace over every committed file, including this evidence tree. Equality was PROVEN, not assumed: JSON artifacts were parsed and compared as objects; text artifacts were compared with trailing whitespace stripped. sha256_as_emitted is what the producer wrote; sha256_as_published is what verifies against the copy in this repository.
